title: Claude Desktop third-party inference configuration (subset written by this tool)
description: Validates the configuration object this tool writes into <configLibrary>/<uuid>.json. It is a strict subset of the full Claude Desktop key space: the tool refuses to emit keys outside it. additionalProperties is true because a user's existing file may legitimately carry other Claude Desktop keys that this tool does not manage.

inferenceProvider.description: Only 'gateway' is emitted. 'anthropic' would bypass the user's gateway; bedrock/vertex/foundry/mantle need credentials this tool never sees.

inferenceGatewayBaseUrl.description: Passed through from ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL. No path suffix is appended.

inferenceGatewayAuthScheme.description: bearer for ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, x-api-key for ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Claude Desktop sends only one.

inferenceCredentialHelper.description: Absolute POSIX path. macOS and Linux run this.

inferenceCredentialHelperWindows.description: Absolute Windows path. Only Windows reads this key.

deploymentMode.description: 3p hides the Claude.ai sign-in and keeps the device on this connection.
